message: How long does standard shipping take and what does it cost?
reference: Standard shipping takes 3-5 business days and costs a flat $6.95, free on orders over $75.

message: Do you ship to the UK?
reference: Yes, UK shipping is available, taking 7-14 business days, and the customer pays any duties and taxes.

message: Can I get a fuel canister shipped to Canada?
reference: No. Fuel canisters cannot be shipped internationally.

message: What time does the Portland store close on Sundays?
reference: The Portland store is open Sundays 11am to 6pm, so it closes at 6pm.

message: Is your phone support open on weekends?
reference: No. Phone support is Monday to Friday 8am-6pm Pacific; chat is available daily 8am-8pm Pacific.

message: How many days do I have to return something?
reference: Unused items with tags attached can be returned within 60 days of purchase.

message: Can I return a clearance item I bought?
reference: No. Clearance items are final sale and cannot be returned or exchanged.

message: Do your hiking boots run big or small?
reference: Boots run about a half size small, and size exchanges are free within 60 days.

message: Will you match a lower price I found at another store?
reference: No. Northwind does not price match competitors.

message: What does the warranty on your backpacks cover?
reference: Northwind-branded packs have a lifetime warranty against manufacturing defects; normal wear and misuse are not covered.

message: How long does a zipper repair take?
reference: About 3 weeks from the day the item is received, and quotes are free.

message: We're a team of 30 and want matching jackets. Do you do bulk discounts?
reference: Yes. Orders of 20 or more of the same item get team pricing; email sales@northwind.example for a quote within 5 business days.

message: Can I use two promo codes on one order?
reference: No. One promo code can be used per order and codes cannot be combined.

message: Do gift cards expire? And how do they get to the person?
reference: E-gift cards never expire and are emailed within minutes of purchase.

message: How many loyalty points do I need for a reward?
reference: 500 points can be redeemed for a $10 reward; you earn 1 point per $1 spent.

message: When will I get a tracking number for my order?
reference: A tracking email is sent within 24 hours of the order shipping.

message: What does Trailhead Club cost and what do I get for it?
reference: $39 per year, with free standard shipping, 10% off orders and early access to sales.

message: What payment methods do you take? Can I pay by check?
reference: Visa, Mastercard, American Express, PayPal, Apple Pay and Klarna pay-later. Personal checks are not accepted.

message: The jacket I bought last week just went on sale. Can I get the difference back?
reference: Yes. If an item drops in price within 14 days of purchase, contact support and the price is adjusted.

message: Can I use Klarna pay-later on a $2,000 order?
reference: No. Klarna pay-later is available on orders between $50 and $1,000.

message: I forgot my password, how do I reset it?
reference: Use the Forgot password link on the sign-in page; the reset link expires after 30 minutes.

message: I asked for a password reset email but it never arrived.
reference: Check the spam folder and confirm you used the email address on your account; the link expires after 30 minutes.

message: How do I change the email address on my account?
reference: Go to Account > Profile and enter your current password.

message: How do I turn on two-factor authentication?
reference: In Account > Security, using an authenticator app.

message: I can't log in. It says my password is wrong but I'm sure it's right.
reference: Use the Forgot password link to reset it; the reset link expires after 30 minutes.

message: I see two charges on my card for a single order.
reference: This is usually a pending authorization hold that drops off within 3-5 business days; if both settle, contact support.

message: My card keeps getting declined at checkout.
reference: It is usually a bank-side block; try another card or contact your bank.

message: Will you charge me for Trailhead Club again next year?
reference: Yes, the membership renews automatically each year, but it can be cancelled at any time.

message: Your checkout page throws an error every time I click pay.
reference: Clear your browser cache or try another browser.

message: The app crashes on my Android 8 phone.
reference: The mobile app requires Android 10 or later (or iOS 16 or later), so Android 8 is not supported.

message: The tracking link in my shipping email doesn't work.
reference: Look up the order at northwind.example/track using the order number and email.
